resale_co.name: Certificate of Compliance / Certificate of Continued Occupancy (CCO), Residential Safety Inspection
resale_co.issued_by: Office of the Fire Marshal (Somerdale Fire Prevention Bureau)
resale_co.lead_time: Apply 11 or more working days before settlement for the lowest fee
requirements: A representative must be on location for the inspection
Lead paint certification for any house built before 1978 (application form; the guideline sheet labels this as for rental properties)
House numbers in Arabic lettering, 3 inches, on the front wall or porch, 30 inches above ground
Smoke alarm on each floor and in each bedroom; 10-year sealed battery alarms where none exist or when replacing battery alarms; hardwired alarms may not be replaced with battery alarms
Carbon monoxide detector on each floor
2A/10BC fire extinguisher, not over 10 lbs, wall mounted about 5 ft from the ground (waist level accepted), within 10 ft of the kitchen and in view
Sidewalks and driveways with no cracks or unevenness, no skim coating or ramping; must be visible and clear of snow, ice and parked cars
Front and rear porch or deck well maintained and sturdy
Windows operable and in decent condition
Firmly secured railing on stairs with 4 or more steps
Water check: toilets flush, drains work, hot water
Covers on all light switches and receptacles
No holes in walls, floors or ceilings; painted
Sump pump must not be tied into the sewer
Yard and property maintained (grass cut, trimmed)
Secondary power source labels on electric panel and meter if there is solar or a generator; solar panels and EV chargers must have been permitted
Any open permits must be closed / finalized

fees.label: Single family, 11+ working days before settlement
Single family, 4 to 10 working days before settlement
Single family, 1 to 3 working days before settlement
Reinspection (each)
fees.quote: A $25.00 FEE WILL BE REQUIRED FOR ALL REINSPECTIONS

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Application for Certificate of Compliance, Single Family Dwelling completely and submit it with a check or money order payable to the Somerdale Fire Prevention Bureau. Contact the Fire Marshal's office at 856-783-6320 ext. 2100 or dmarx@somerdale-nj.com. Borough Hall is at 105 Kennedy Blvd, open Mon to Thu 8 AM to 5:15 PM, closed Friday.

evidence.quote: The Office of the Fire Marshal is responsible for inspections not only for Special Events, but inspections prior to a new business opening as well as Certificate of Occupancy inspections prior to settlement on the purchase of a home or renting to a tenant.
If you are moving into Somerdale, or renting a property, you are required to have your property inspected before you move in.
A CHECK OR MONEY ORDER PAYABLE TO THE SOMERDALE FIRE PREVENTION BUREAU MUST ACCOMPANY THIS APPLICATION AND MUST BE SUBMITTTED UNDER THE FOLLOWING PAY SCHEDULE:
GUIDELINE FOR RESIDENTIAL SAFETY INSPECTION (CCO) (THIS IS ONLY A SAMPLE OF ITEMS THE INSPECTOR MAY CHECK FOR)

resale_co.notes: In Somerdale one inspection by the Fire Marshal's office covers both the town resale certificate and the smoke/CO/extinguisher items. The application and guideline PDFs are scanned images, so quotes were transcribed from the page images (the fee column has alignment spaces between $ and the number). The published application is for a single family dwelling; no separate 2-family sale form was found. A separate rental Certificate of Compliance application (Word doc, same fee schedule) and landlord registration apply to rentals. Construction office (open permits): 856-783-6320 ext. 1500, mwadleigh@somerdale-nj.com.

requirements: Smoke alarm on each floor and in each bedroom
10-year sealed battery alarms where no alarms exist or when replacing battery alarms; hardwired alarms must not be replaced with battery alarms
Carbon monoxide detector on each floor
2A/10BC fire extinguisher, not to exceed 10 lbs, wall mounted about 5 ft from the ground (waist level accepted), within 10 ft of the kitchen, in view
Secondary power source labels on electric panel and meter (as of 2/3/25) where solar or generators exist

authorities.lead_time: 11 or more working days before settlement for the lowest fee

fees.label: Combined CCO and smoke/CO/extinguisher inspection, 11+ working days before settlement

authorities.how_to_apply: Same application as the CCO: submit the Single Family Dwelling Certificate of Compliance application with a check or money order payable to the Somerdale Fire Prevention Bureau.

evidence.quote: FIRE EXTINGUISHER (INSTALLED 5 FT. FROM GROUND, MOUNTED ON THE WALL, WITHIN 10 FT OF THE KITCHEN IN VIEW OF PUBLIC) (MOUNTED WAIST LEVEL IS ACCEPTED) MUST BE A 2A/10BC FIRE EXTINGUISHER, not to exceed 10lbs.

SMOKE ALARMS (1 ON EACH FLOOR AND IN EACH BEDROOM) Ten Year Sealed battery-powered single station smoke alarms shall be installed where no smoke alarms exit or when replacing similar battery-powered single station smoke alarms.

fire_cert.notes: No separate smoke certificate fee was found; the fire safety items are part of the single CCO inspection run by the Fire Marshal's office. Somerdale's May 2026 guideline still requires a fire extinguisher.

other_items.label: Open permits must be closed
other_items.detail: Any open permits must be closed / finalized; solar panels and EV chargers must have been permitted.

other_items.label: Lead paint certification for pre-1978 homes
other_items.detail: The single family application states any house built before 1978 must have a lead paint certification provided (citing N.J. P.L. 2021, c. 182, the rental lead law).

open_questions: Which form and fee applies to a 2-family home sale (only a single family application is published).
Whether the pre-1978 lead paint certification is enforced on owner-occupied sales or only when the buyer will rent (the guideline sheet says rental properties).
